title: CRDT property test: merge idempotency
description:
Write a proptest asserting that reconciling a log with itself produces empty want/have sets (idempotency). Also: appending the same entry twice to a log produces the same result as appending once. Artifact: added to crates/core/tests/crdt_properties.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- 1000 random cases checked per run
- Idempotency holds for all cases
- Test fails immediately and reports the seed on violation
